evals.prompt: Generate a mono 22050 Hz, 16-bit explosion WAV and preserve the editable source.
evals.expected_output: A validated wrapper command with a semantic output name, explicit format, source preservation, and post-generation inspection.
assertions: The output uses the explosion preset
The output preserves an rFX source for future tuning
The output checks file existence and audio metadata
The output recommends auditioning and checking clipping

evals.prompt: rFXGen will not build on a clean machine. Explain a safe diagnosis path.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis that checks for an existing binary, then CMake/toolchain/dependency availability and pinned source-build evidence.
assertions: The output prefers checking an existing binary or official web tool first
The output checks CMake and a desktop C toolchain
The output mentions possible raylib/platform dependency or network requirements
The output recommends a separate build directory
The output does not claim a build succeeded without command evidence
